title: Bilateral intent planning and execution enforcement
requirements: Project confirmed positive and negative requirements, semantics, guardrails, and exact source identity through Compass and Atlas.
Reject ineligible candidate plans before weighted scoring or Council deliberation.
Route semantic, confirmation, authority, and guardrail changes back to human reconfirmation.
Bind every Act Capsule, Shadow gate, patch boundary, verification result, and Judge decision to the confirmed bilateral contract.
Bind controlled Surgeon sessions to a temporary identity, repair budget, confirmed effects, revision, and expiry.
Expose a minimum-sufficient bilateral micro-context and bounded MCP refinement and revision tools.
prohibitions: Do not create a parallel intent, semantic, memory, policy, verification, or learning owner.
Do not let Council, model agreement, or weighted scoring override a deterministic bilateral denial.
Do not silently widen source paths, authority, meaning, or guardrails after confirmation.
Do not grant patch, commit, push, pull request, merge, deployment, production, or learning-promotion authority.
Do not include Runtime V2, Construction, incident capture, canary, Foundry runtime, or spatial projection work.
Do not trigger external reviewers before implementation and verification are complete.
